descByPlatform.chatgpt: Medium Shot Art Exhibition Poster for FIELDS OF FEELING Irene Kavanagh solo show. Subject: abstract hero painting by fictional artist occupying 20-78% x 18-66% y, gestural oil-on-linen strokes — deep cobalt #1E3A8A sweeping diagonal, cadmium scarlet #D62828 horizontal slash, ochre #C9A96A low bar, on raw-linen ground #D9CCB2 with visible weave; impasto ridges catch raking light, drip trails at lower edge. Composition: Rule of Thirds painting mass, Centered 50% x hero vertical, generous lower margin for type, AR 2:3. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 80mm LS at f/11, 1/125s, ISO 50, tripod, focus-stacked 4 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Side Lighting + Raking — 4×6ft softbox camera-left 25° grazing 2m (key raking impasto), 4×4ft white bounce camera-right 1.2m (fill), 4×4ft black flag overhead to kill ceiling bounce. Material physics: oil-paint impasto specular ridge, linen weave tooth, cracked pigment edge. Typography: 'FIELDS OF FEELING · IRENE KAVANAGH' 36pt Cormorant Garamond italic raw-linen #D9CCB2 centred 50% x 72% y; subhead 'APRIL 18 - JUNE 30 · METROPOLITAN GALLERY' 14pt Inter Medium tracking-200 #D9CCB2 centred 50% x 86% y. Color grade: Capture One Gallery-Warm LUT grain 8 +0.0 EV. Palette: linen #D9CCB2 38%, cobalt #1E3A8A 22%, scarlet #D62828 18%, ochre #C9A96A 14%, shadow 8%. References: Helen Frankenthaler, Joan Mitchell, Cy Twombly. Exclude: photo texture, clean vector, harsh flash, frame glare, digital gradient.
